svg.title: The lag-1 plot exposes a weak generator that summary statistics miss: its 400 draws are only 20 distinct values on 7 straight lines, while a well-chosen generator fills the square.
svg.desc: Two square scatter plots, each showing every value plotted against the value that follows it. On the left, the generator x becomes 7x plus 3 modulo 1000 produces points that lie exactly on seven parallel straight lines, only 20 distinct positions in total, because the sequence cycles after 20 values. On the right, the generator x becomes 1664525x plus 1013904223 modulo 2 to the 32 produces 400 points spread evenly across the square with no visible pattern. Both generators have a mean near one half and a similar spread; only this plot separates them.
svg.text: Each value against the next: the plot that finds a bad generator
